circuit_screen.role: Pull U4 enable low and discharge its external VIO rail; not the modem supply switch

circuit_screen.limits: The 25C RDS table does not guarantee 6 ohm over temperature or startup with a falling gate rail. Capacitor discharge is a short pulse above the 50mA RDS test current. Powered fault/rail-collapse tests and assembled thermal/current bounds remain required.
